# PDB-101

> > Educational portal from RCSB Protein Data Bank exploring molecular structures, structural biology, and biomolecular mechanisms through Molecule of the Month articles, teaching resources, and scientific highlights.

PDB-101 serves as the educational outreach platform for the Protein Data Bank, making structural biology accessible through illustrated articles, educational materials, and visualizations. Supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation, National Institutes of Health, and Department of Energy, it features contributions from the Protein Structure Initiative (PSI) and showcases molecular structures determined by X-ray crystallography and electron microscopy.

## Key Topics

- Protein Data Bank (PDB)
- RCSB PDB
- Structural biology
- Protein structure
- Molecular visualization
- Crystallography
- Electron microscopy
- Ribosome
- DNA structure
- Protein Structure Initiative (PSI)
- Molecule of the Month
- Molecular machinery
- Membrane proteins
- Enzyme mechanisms
- Drug design

## Molecule of the Month Articles

- [Photosynthetic Supercomplexes](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/244): Photosystem II & LHCII antenna complexes capture light in supercomplexes
- [Expressome](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/253): Bacterial expressome couples transcription & translation via RNA polymerase
- [Cellulose Synthase](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/254): Plant cellulose synthase builds tough cellulose strands one sugar at a time
- [Secretory Antibodies](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/272): Secretory immunoglobulins provide first-line mucosal defense vs pathogens
- [SNARE Proteins](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/167): SNARE proteins power vesicle-membrane fusion via alpha helix bundles
- [Dipeptidyl Peptidase 4](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/202): DPP4 enzyme inhibitors treat type-2 diabetes via incretin regulation
- [Ricin](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/161): Ricin toxin structure reveals ribosome inactivation & vaccine mechanisms
- [DNA Ligase](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/55): DNA ligase repairs broken DNA strands & enables recombinant DNA engineering
- [Potassium Channels](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/38): Potassium channels selectively pass K+ ions while blocking smaller Na+ ions
- [Src Tyrosine Kinase](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/43): Src tyrosine kinase growth signaling protein's role in cancer development
- [Anabolic Steroids](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/motm/92): Testosterone & anabolic steroids as performance enhancing drugs

## Structural Biology Research Highlights

- [Iron-Sulfur Cluster Biosynthesis](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/structural-biology-highlights/iron-sulfur-cluster-biosynthesis): PSI research on iron-sulfur cluster biosynthesis machinery & ISC system
- [Deciphering Microbial DUFs](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/structural-biology-highlights/deciphering-microbial-dufs): PSI characterization of microbial domains of unknown function (DUFs)

## Educational Materials & Flyers

- [How do Drugs Work?](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/flyers-posters-and-calendars/flyer/how-do-drugs-work): Educational flyer on drug mechanisms using PDB structures & antibiotics
- [2024 Calendar: Peak Performance](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/flyers-posters-and-calendars/calendar/2024-calendar-peak-performance): 2024 calendar exploring biomolecules in athletic peak performance
- [Award-winning Clathrin Illustration](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/flyers-posters-and-calendars/poster/award-winning-clathrin-illustration): Maria Voigt's Wellcome Trust award-winning clathrin illustration poster
- [Award-winning Illustration of Bacteriophage T4 Infection](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/flyers-posters-and-calendars/poster/award-winning-illustration-of-bacteriophage-t4-infection): David Goodsell's award-winning bacteriophage T4 infection illustration

## Interactive Resources & Media

- [PDB50 the Game](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/other-resources/pdb50-the-game): Worker placement board game exploring protein structure discovery process
- [Artificial lattice of a designed DNA crystal](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/videos/artificial-lattice-of-a-designed-dna-crystal): Video of engineered DNA forming nanoscale crystal lattice structures
